verdict.rationale: Authy handles user account data, so a buyer can fairly ask whether that data is excluded from AI model training. The evidence pack has no AI-training policy, opt-out control, or data-use commitment. Encrypted backups and device protections are adjacent security features, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
